Frequently Asked Questions

What is Downloadify?▼
Downloadify is a free, browser-based online tool that lets users download permitted video and audio files from URLs. It supports six formats — MP3 320kbps, MP3 128kbps, M4A, FLAC, MP4, and WebM — and requires no software installation or account.
Is Downloadify free to use?▼
Yes, Downloadify is completely free to use. There are no subscription tiers, no credit card requirements, and no hidden fees.
Do I need to install software?▼
No. Downloadify is entirely browser-based. It works on any device with a web browser — including phones, tablets, and computers — without installing apps, extensions, or desktop software.
What file formats are supported?▼
We support MP3 (320kbps and 128kbps), M4A (AAC), FLAC (lossless), MP4 (video), and WebM (video). You can choose the format that best fits your needs before downloading.
Is it legal to download videos from links?▼
Downloading videos from links is legal when you own the content, have explicit permission from the creator, or the content is in the public domain, Creative Commons-licensed, or otherwise freely available. Downloading copyrighted content without permission is not legal in most jurisdictions. Downloadify is designed for permitted use only.
Does Downloadify store my files or track my downloads?▼
No. Files are processed temporarily and automatically removed after delivery. We do not log your URLs, your downloads, or your browsing activity. Downloadify is built on privacy by design.
Can I use Downloadify on my phone?▼
Yes. Downloadify works on any device with a web browser, including iPhones, Android phones, and tablets. No app installation is needed.
Can creators use Downloadify to back up their content?▼
Yes. Downloadify is ideal for creators saving their own uploaded videos, audio, and media for backup or editing purposes. You can also download public-domain, Creative Commons, and royalty-free content for your projects.
